cards.name: Infinite Rizz

cards.name: Big Bald Energy
cards.comicEnding: An absurdly restrained single punch clears the arena; the expired coupon matters more.

cards.name: The Eternal 2nd
cards.comicEnding: The gigantic beam earns second place; a tiny silver medal lands in his hand.

cards.name: Sauron Surveillance
cards.ability: One Eye to Track Them All
cards.comicEnding: The all-seeing eye buries the scene in policy paper, then accepts all cookies.

cards.name: Fraudo Baggins
cards.ability: One Ring to Refer Them All
cards.comicEnding: The referral ring unravels the welcome carpet and his entire investment pitch.

cards.name: Daenerys Airfryer
cards.comicEnding: Three terrifying countertop fryers must politely finish preheating before one crisped projectile.

cards.name: Light Yagamod
cards.comicEnding: His perfect purge bans his appeal channel and tech support.

cards.name: Copy-Paste Kakashi
cards.comicEnding: A paper clone attacks backwards under a giant watermark.

cards.name: Yasuo 0/10
cards.comicEnding: The perfect sword dash takes the wrong exit; the defeat counter reaches ten.

cards.name: L Ratio
cards.comicEnding: Every piece of evidence is correct; a literal letter L wins the argument.

cards.name: Erwin LinkedIn
cards.comicEnding: He rallies the workforce into a chart; the graph receives the promotion.

cards.name: Gandalf the Grey Market
cards.comicEnding: The grand magical stand becomes an unlicensed shop and a rolling shutter.

cards.name: GenOS Windows Update
cards.comicEnding: The transformation stalls at 99 percent; victory is followed by a very late startup chime.

cards.name: Sully Sullivan HR
cards.comicEnding: A motivational roar gets him fired; his severance blanket still protects the squad.

cards.name: Olaf Global Warming
cards.comicEnding: A snowman melts during his sponsored campaign, then delivers squad cooling with a fan.

cards.name: Dutch Pyramid Scheme
cards.comicEnding: His next payment plan becomes a gold pyramid that collapses across the scene.

cards.name: Absent Father
cards.comicEnding: The powerful fighter charges up, sees a family bill, and instantly disappears.

cards.name: Anti-Anti-Meat Activist
cards.comicEnding: A furious pirate rescues a barbecue from a salad and celebrates the wrong moral victory.

cards.name: Power of Friendship
cards.comicEnding: An epic friendship attack brings so many flashbacks that the ending needs a recap.

cards.name: Touch Grass Final Boss
cards.comicEnding: A giant leaf drags the incident offline; the final boss becomes distracted by a tiny phone.
